disclaimer: Style recommendations describe classical proportion balancing. Personal expression, hair texture, and individual preference always override general guidelines.

shapes.name: Oval
shapes.description: Balanced proportions where face length is roughly 1.5 times the width, with gently rounded jawline and forehead.
shapes.barber_summary: Versatile proportions. Most cuts work well; focus on maintaining natural balance without over-elongating.

haircuts.top: Textured crop, slick back, quiff, or classic taper — almost any height or volume works.
haircuts.sides: Low to medium fade, taper, or classic scissor cut.
haircuts.fringe: Can wear up, down, textured, or swept to the side.

beard_options.effect: Highlights the natural clean lines of the jaw and balanced bone structure.
Adds subtle texture and definition without altering proportions.
Keeps cheeks neat while adding slight presence to the lower chin if desired.
Can add perceived length if kept heavy on the chin; keep cheeks trimmed to avoid rounding.

shapes.eyebrow_tips: Natural, medium-thick arch with clean grooming. Avoid overly thin or severe shapes.
what_to_avoid: Excessive height on top combined with very tight sides, which can over-elongate the face.
Heavy fringe that completely hides the forehead if you prefer balanced proportions.

shapes.name: Round
shapes.description: Face width and length are nearly equal, with soft curves at the jaw and hairline and minimal sharp angles.
shapes.barber_summary: Tends to benefit from height on top and tight sides to create vertical elongation.

haircuts.top: High pompadour, quiff, faux hawk, or high-volume textured crop to add vertical height.
haircuts.sides: Skin fade, high taper, or sharp short sides to reduce perceived width at the temples and cheeks.
haircuts.fringe: Angled or swept up; avoid blunt horizontal fringe which emphasizes width.
haircuts.parting: Deep side part to add asymmetry and angles.

beard_options.effect: Clean look; relies entirely on hair styling for angular contrast.
Light shadow defines the cheek contours gently.
Lengthens the chin visually, drawing the eye downward and reducing roundness.
Keeping cheeks short and chin longer creates a sharper, more defined jawline.

shapes.eyebrow_tips: Angular, higher-arched brows help introduce vertical lines and balance rounded curves.
what_to_avoid: Very short, blunt bangs that cut straight across.
Full bushy sideburns and rounded frames that echo face roundness.

shapes.name: Square
shapes.description: Strong, angular jawline with forehead and jaw width nearly matching, creating a bold, defined perimeter.
shapes.barber_summary: Tends to benefit from softening harsh angles on the sides while keeping top clean or textured.

haircuts.top: Buzz cut, crew cut, textured French crop, or moderate quiff.
haircuts.sides: Taper fade or classic medium scissor cut that doesn't exaggerate the boxy jaw.
haircuts.fringe: Textured forward fringe or soft brushed back.

beard_options.effect: Showcases the naturally strong jawline cleanly.
Softens the skin while preserving masculine jaw definition.
Introduces curved lines that soften the sharp corners of the jaw.
Draws focus to the center of the lower face.

shapes.eyebrow_tips: Slightly rounded or naturally groomed brows to soften strong facial angles.
what_to_avoid: Very boxy, heavy geometric frames that amplify angular features.
Blunt, squared-off haircuts with flat tops.

shapes.name: Rectangle / Oblong
shapes.description: Face length is noticeably greater than width, with a straight jawline and balanced forehead/cheek proportions.
shapes.barber_summary: Tends to benefit from width on the sides and reduced height on top to avoid lengthening.

haircuts.top: Side sweep, textured fringe, messy crop, or medium-length flow kept flatter on top.
haircuts.sides: Medium taper or scissors-over-comb (avoid skin fades on high sides which lengthen further).
haircuts.fringe: Forward fringe or side sweep to shorten the perceived forehead length.

beard_options.effect: Clean, classic presentation; highlights length.
Adding fullness on the cheeks and sideburns widens the face visually.
Fills out the lower cheeks, balancing the vertical length.

shapes.eyebrow_tips: Straight, horizontal grooming helps shorten the vertical appearance of the face.
what_to_avoid: High pompadours or extreme top volume that stretches the face further.

shapes.name: Heart
shapes.description: Broader forehead and cheekbones tapering down to a narrow, pointed chin.
shapes.barber_summary: Tends to benefit from volume around the jaw/chin and soft texture on the forehead.

haircuts.top: Medium-length textured mop, side-swept fringe, or medium quiff.
haircuts.sides: Medium taper or scissor cut (avoid high skin fades that accentuate a wide upper head).
haircuts.fringe: Side-swept fringe that covers part of the forehead.

beard_options.effect: Highlights delicate chin structure.
Adds crucial width and substance to the narrow jaw and chin area.
Fills out the lower face evenly to balance upper face width.

shapes.eyebrow_tips: Soft, gently curved brows that do not add unnecessary upper weight.

shapes.name: Diamond
shapes.description: Narrow forehead and jawline with wider, prominent cheekbones.
shapes.barber_summary: Tends to benefit from width at the forehead and chin, with softer textured sides.

haircuts.top: Textured fringe, messy top, or forward sweep with volume at the temples.
haircuts.sides: Scissor-cut taper or medium length (avoid extreme skin fades that expose wide cheekbones).
haircuts.fringe: Forward texture to add forehead width.
haircuts.parting: Messy side part or textured crop.

beard_options.effect: Shows cheekbone definition clearly.
Adds weight and fullness to the narrow chin, balancing prominent cheekbones.
Softens the angular cheek transition.

shapes.eyebrow_tips: Low, softly curved brows help soften the upper face angles.
what_to_avoid: Very tight sides paired with flat top, which exaggerates cheekbone width.
